entry.title: Awesome Streaming Updates on Apr 15 - Apr 21, 2019
entry.content:
Table of Contents / Engines and Platforms

  • Apache Apex (⭐350) - Unified platform for big data stream and batch processing.
  • Apache Flink (⭐26k) - Distributed engine for stateful computation over bounded and unbounded data streams.
  • Apache Kafka (⭐33k) - Distributed event streaming platform for high-performance data pipelines and applications.
  • Apache Samza (⭐846) - Distributed stream processing framework built on Apache Kafka with standalone and YARN deployment options.
  • Apache Spark Streaming (⭐44k) - Scalable, fault-tolerant stream processing on Apache Spark.
  • Esper (⭐875) - Complex event processing, Streaming SQL, and event series analysis engine.
  • hailstorm (⭐94) - Distributed stream processing with exactly-once semantics based on Storm.
  • Hazelcast Jet (⭐1.1k) - Stream and batch processing engine whose development moved into Hazelcast Platform.
  • Onyx (⭐2.1k) - Distributed, masterless, fault-tolerant data processing platform.
  • SABER (⭐44) - Window-based hybrid CPU/GPU stream processing engine.
  • SPQR (⭐30) - Dynamic framework for processing high-volume data streams through pipelines.
  • Teknek (⭐10) - Stream processing platform with the interactive Stream Operator Language shell.

Table of Contents / Libraries, SDKs, and Programming Models

  • Apache Kafka Streams (⭐33k) - Stream processing library included with Apache Kafka.
  • coast (⭐60) - DSL that builds exactly-once dataflow graphs on top of Apache Samza.
  • Faust (⭐6.8k) - Deprecated Python stream processing library inspired by Kafka Streams.
  • samza-luwak (⭐100) - Integration of Apache Samza with the Luwak stored-query engine for full-text stream search.
  • Swave (⭐173) - Lightweight Reactive Streams infrastructure toolkit for Scala.

Table of Contents / Applications and Tools

  • straw (⭐103) - Platform for real-time streaming search.
  • StreamAlert (⭐2.9k) - Airbnb serverless framework for real-time security log analysis and alerting.
  • StreamFlow (⭐256) - Tool for building and monitoring stream processing workflows.
  • StreamingBandit (⭐85) - Web application for setting up and evaluating contextual multi-armed bandit experiments.
  • Streamline (⭐167) - Hortonworks visual stream analytics framework built around engines such as Apache Storm.
  • Turbine (⭐833) - Netflix tool for aggregating Server-Sent Event JSON streams.

Table of Contents / Benchmarks

  • storm-perf-test (⭐75) - Apache Storm performance and stress test.
  • streaming-benchmarks (⭐647) - Benchmarks for low-latency stream processing systems including Storm, Spark, and Flink.
entry.summary: 25 awesome projects updated on Apr 15 - Apr 21, 2019
